title: 3d Meshes Compression
description: This project goal was to implement the fast SQUEEZE CPM algorithm in order to compress 3D meshes and dynamically stream the decompression with multiple Levels of Detail (LOD). This is widely used in 3D environments such as video games, in order to gain memory. If the camera is far, the object will be low-detailed, and the farther it approaches the object, the more detailed it will be.

title: 3DFlight Software Visualization
description: Development of an interactive 3D application with the aim of promoting the role of a satellite flight software for external and internal communications. Simultaneously worked on a Proof of Concept for 3D post mortem visualisations of flight software interactions.

title: Graph Theory Projec
description: This project is made for the Graph theory course of my school. The goal is to visualize and annalyse the graph representing a cluster of satellites. For this project, the choice of the tools was free. I chose to use Unity in the goal of better representing the situation and expand my knowledge on the engine.

title: Penguin Survivors
description: This game project originated from a "Pass the game" Game Jam organized by my school game dev club. The goal of the game is to survive each wave of enemy penguins, by shooting snowballs at them.

title: Rapport Tav
description: This project was made for a school project featuring differents image processing algorithms coded from scratch in Matlab. I figured that a more immersive way of demonstrating my work was to make a website to try out the algorithms yourself. For this to work I had to host it on a AWS instance due to Matlab license issues.

title: Sausage Serenity
description: This game was made as a participation of the Global Game Jam 2024. The theme of this yeear was Make me laugh. In this game you play as a sausage dog and wonder in a ciy filled with depression. As you make your way through the city, you'll meet various characters and have to respond to their requests to restore their laughter. The goal of the game is to make the city a better place.

title: Space Travelers
description: In this game, two players play against each others, as the aliens vs the astronauts, competiting for the holy chicken. Each player chan choose X different character to play and will play turn by turn. Each round the replays of the previous ones are played and you can interact with them. The goal of the game is to be the players with most chicken captured at the end of the game.
